market.question: Will "Virgin River: Season 7" be the #2 US Netflix show this week?
market.description:
Netflix is expected to update its Top 10 TV shows list on top10.netflix.com on Tuesday, March 17, 2026, 3:00 PM ET, reflecting viewership from the previous week (Monday to Sunday).

This market will resolve based on which show this update ranks as the #2 Netflix show in the United States.

The ranking is based on total views in the United States, as reported by Netflix for TV shows.

If the top10.netflix.com update does not occur by March 20, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".
